title: can and could
summary: **can** — «могу, умею» (сейчас), **could** — «мог, умел» (в прошлом); а также вежливые просьбы: **Can/Could you ...?**
ru:
## can: умею или могу
**can + глагол** говорит, что мы умеем что-то делать или что это возможно.
> I can swim. — Я умею плавать.
> Sara can speak French. — Сара говорит по-французски.
> We can't come tomorrow. — Мы не сможем прийти завтра.

## Как строится
- **can** одинаково для всех лиц, без -s: *he can* (не ~~he cans~~)
- после can — глагол без **to**: ~~I can to swim~~ → I can swim
- отрицание: **can't** (cannot)
- вопрос: **Can** you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

## could — прошлое от can
О прошлом говорим **could / couldn't** («мог / не мог»).
> When I was five, I could read. — Когда мне было пять, я умел читать.
> I was tired, but I couldn't sleep. — Я устала, но не могла уснуть.
> Could you swim when you were ten? — Ты умел плавать в десять лет?

## Просьбы: Can you ...? Could you ...?
Можно просить людей сделать что-то: **Can you ...?** или чуть вежливее **Could you ...?**
> Can you open the window, please? — Открой окно, пожалуйста.
> Could you help me, please? — Не могли бы вы мне помочь?

## Разрешение: Can I ...? Could I ...?
Чтобы спросить разрешения, говорим **Can I ...? / Could I ...?**
> Can I sit here? — Можно мне здесь сесть?
> Could I use your phone? — Можно воспользоваться вашим телефоном?
Could I ...? звучит вежливее.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~He cans swim.~~ → He **can** swim.
- ~~I can to help you.~~ → I can help you.
- ~~Do you can swim?~~ → **Can** you swim?
- ~~I can't to sleep.~~ → I **can't** sleep.
- ~~Yesterday I can't come.~~ → Yesterday I **couldn't** come.
en:
## can: ability and possibility
We use **can** to say that someone knows how to do something, or that something is possible.
> I can swim.
> Sara can speak French.
> We can't come tomorrow.

## How to make it
- **can** is the same for all persons: *he can* (not ~~he cans~~)
- no **to** after can: ~~I can to swim~~ → I can swim
- negative: **can't** (cannot)
- question: **Can** you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

## could: the past of can
For the past we use **could / couldn't**.
> When I was five, I could read.
> I was tired, but I couldn't sleep.
> Could you swim when you were ten?

## Asking people to do things
We say **Can you ...?** or, more politely, **Could you ...?**
> Can you open the window, please?
> Could you help me, please?

## Asking for permission
We say **Can I ...? / Could I ...?** **Could I ...?** is more polite.
> Can I sit here?
> Could I use your phone?

## Common mistakes
- ~~He cans swim.~~ → He **can** swim.
- ~~Do you can swim?~~ → **Can** you swim?
- ~~Yesterday I can't come.~~ → Yesterday I **couldn't** come.
structure:
## Утверждение и отрицание
| Подлежащее | can / could | Глагол |
|---|---|---|
| I / you / we / they | can / can't | swim |
| he / she / it | can / can't | swim |
| I / he / she / we / you / they | could / couldn't | swim |

## Вопрос и краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Краткие ответы |
|---|---|
| Can you swim? | Yes, I can. / No, I can't. |
| Can she cook? | Yes, she can. / No, she can't. |
| Could you run fast? | Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't. |

## Формулы
> Подлежащее + **can / can't** + глагол без to
> **Can** + подлежащее + глагол?
> Просьба: **Can / Could you** + глагол, please?
> Разрешение: **Can / Could I** + глагол?

## Запомните
- **can't = cannot** (пишется слитно, не ~~can not~~);
- время только одно: **can** (сейчас) и **could** (раньше);
- в будущем вместо can говорят **will be able to** (позже).

items.text: A fish {{can}} swim, but it {{can't|cannot}} walk.
Anna is only two. She {{can't|cannot}} read yet.
I {{can}} play the guitar. I learned it at school.
My grandfather is 90. He {{can't|cannot}} run fast now.
{{Can}} you help me with this bag, please?
Last night I was very tired. I {{couldn't|could not}} stay awake.
When Tom was young, he {{could}} run very fast.
I'm sorry, I {{can't|cannot}} come to your party tomorrow.
The shop was closed yesterday. We {{couldn't|could not}} buy bread.
Now I {{can}} understand English films, but a year ago I {{couldn't|could not}}.
{{Could}} you speak English when you were ten?
